# Chapter 2: What I Would Tell Them — Life Lessons

---

## Historical Context

The grandparent-grandchild relationship occupies a unique position in the human lifespan. Unlike the parent-child bond — charged with responsibility, expectation, and the anxiety of shaping a life — the grandparent relationship offers something rarer: unconditional positive regard untainted by obligation. Bob has earned the right to speak not as an authority but as a witness. He has seen the outcomes of choices made
